meta.name: tfx-doctor
meta.description: triflux 진단 및 수리 도구. AskUserQuestion 기반 인터랙티브 선택지로 CLI 미발견, HUD 미표시, 캐시 오류, 스킬 미설치 등을 진단하고 자동 수정합니다. Use when: not working, broken, error, 안 돼, 이상해, 에러, 캐시, reset, doctor

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动诊断 Triflux 报错,一键修复 CLI、界面与技能运行问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果使用 Triflux 时遇到报错、界面缺失或技能未安装,想一键自动修复。
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose and fix Triflux issues to restore CLI, HUD, and skills automatically.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Triflux and hit broken CLI, missing HUD, or uninstalled skills and want one-click repair.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会启动 triflux 检修向导:让你选“诊断/修复/缓存/重置”,运行 doctor 命令,把状态列成表格,有问题时问是否自动修复或删除缓存。
howto.when: 当你说出“not working”“error”“doctor”等关键词,或描述 CLI 未找到、HUD 未显示、缓存出错等故障时触发。

say.text: CLI 不见了,HUD 也不显示,帮我诊断一下。
say.note: 会弹出诊断/修复/缓存/重置菜单。

say.text: 先做个只读检查,别改任何东西。
say.note: 进入诊断模式,输出状态表格。

say.text: 把所有缓存都清掉,重新生成。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude opens a triflux troubleshooting wizard: it asks you to choose Diagnose/Fix/Cache/Reset, runs the doctor command, shows status in a table, and asks whether to auto-fix or delete caches when issues are found.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords such as "not working", "error", or "doctor", or describe a missing CLI, missing HUD, cache errors, or similar faults.

say_en.text: The CLI is gone and the HUD isn't showing. Diagnose it.
Run a read-only check; don't modify anything.
say_en.note: Runs diagnose mode and prints a status table.

say_en.text: Clear all caches and regenerate them.
